text:
maya: Starting a Terraform apply for multi-region IAM changes during the 04:00-06:00 UTC change window. Need to serialize region applies because IAM API rate limits hit last time. Can we do a canary to us-east-1 then roll east->eu->apac? Will pin provider versions and keep a rollback snapshot.

deploy-bot: Scheduled TF apply job #9876. Plan URL: https://ci.internal/runs/9876/plan

kevin: Ran terraform plan in staging — saw 3 IAM role replacements. Staging took ~90s each due to external api throttling.

kevin: Suggest doing module-level targets to reduce blast radius: terraform apply -target=module.iam_us_east -auto-approve

julian: Also let's pin aws provider to 4.30.0 in required_providers. We had drift from 4.31 that changed default role pathing.

maya: Good call julian. I'll add provider pin in a tiny PR and gate the apply on that merge.

anita: +1 on canary. Also prepare rollback snapshot: terraform state pull > state/backup/1796034567-us-east-1.tfstate.json

charlie: For serialization we can run region jobs serially from the CD system (one pipeline per region) and add a manual approval between canary and remaining regions.

maya: Can someone add a preflight checklist in the run: health dashboard, svc tokens validated, quick smoke: create-session API.

kevin: Preflight smoke output (staging):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://us-east-1.api.internal/session | jq '.ok'
# true
```

sre-bot: Alert: last IAM apply caused 5min spike in request latency for auth service. Recommend 5m pause after canary.

maya: Plan: 1) merge provider pin PR 2) run canary apply us-east-1 3) wait 5m, run smoke and SLO check 4) if green, trigger serial applies for eu, apac with manual approvals between regions 5) if failure, snapshot state and run rollback instructions.

charlie: I'll create the pipeline steps now and tag ops for manual approval slots.

deploy-bot: Run #9876 (canary-us-east-1) started by maya at 1796034600. Status: in_progress

maya: I'll be on standby during 04:00-06:00 UTC. Paging channel: #eng-oncall if anything odd.

kevin: Added a short rollback snippet in the run notes:
```
# restore state and run apply to revert
terraform state push state/backup/1796034567-us-east-1.tfstate.json
terraform apply -auto-approve
```

julian: Remember to remove -parallelism override; we want the runtime to batch where possible, just serialize region-level runs.

maya: Thanks team — updating run description and preflight checklist. Will post plan link when PR merges.
